form.title: Timepoint DMR (lrsomatic dev, test)
form.description: TEST: compares every other tumor sample in the selected lrsomatic dev result datasets with the baseline sample (for example S4 vs S1 and S6 vs S1). The source runs must have been launched with Phased methylation pileup ticked.

baseline_sample.title: Baseline sample
baseline_sample.description: Full name of the earliest timepoint tumor sample, exactly as in the result datasets (for example P4_tumor_full). Every other tumor sample is compared with it.

extra_params_json.title: Extra Parameters (JSON)
extra_params_json.description: Optional: provide additional workflow parameters as a JSON object. These override the form values, except comparisons, outdir, igenomes_base, monochrome_logs, custom_config_base, custom_config_version, validate_params, igenomes_ignore and genome, which are rejected. Maximum 10000 characters.
